WITH claim_amounts AS (
  SELECT
    ca.Claim_Identifier,
    SUM(CASE WHEN lp.Claim_Amount_Identifier IS NOT NULL THEN ca.Claim_Amount ELSE 0 END) AS loss_payment_amount,
    SUM(CASE WHEN lr.Claim_Amount_Identifier IS NOT NULL THEN ca.Claim_Amount ELSE 0 END) AS loss_reserve_amount,
    SUM(CASE WHEN ep.Claim_Amount_Identifier IS NOT NULL THEN ca.Claim_Amount ELSE 0 END) AS expense_payment_amount,
    SUM(CASE WHEN er.Claim_Amount_Identifier IS NOT NULL THEN ca.Claim_Amount ELSE 0 END) AS expense_reserve_amount
  FROM "acme_insurance"."main"."claim_amount" ca
  LEFT JOIN "acme_insurance"."main"."loss_payment" lp
    ON lp.Claim_Amount_Identifier = ca.Claim_Amount_Identifier
  LEFT JOIN "acme_insurance"."main"."loss_reserve" lr
    ON lr.Claim_Amount_Identifier = ca.Claim_Amount_Identifier
  LEFT JOIN "acme_insurance"."main"."expense_payment" ep
    ON ep.Claim_Amount_Identifier = ca.Claim_Amount_Identifier
  LEFT JOIN "acme_insurance"."main"."expense_reserve" er
    ON er.Claim_Amount_Identifier = ca.Claim_Amount_Identifier
  GROUP BY ca.Claim_Identifier
),
claim_policies AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT
    c.Claim_Identifier,
    c.Company_Claim_Number,
    p.Policy_Identifier,
    p.Policy_Number
  FROM "acme_insurance"."main"."claim" c
  JOIN "acme_insurance"."main"."claim_coverage" cc
    ON cc.Claim_Identifier = c.Claim_Identifier
  JOIN "acme_insurance"."main"."policy_coverage_detail" pcd
    ON pcd.Policy_Coverage_Detail_Identifier = cc.Policy_Coverage_Detail_Identifier
   AND pcd.Effective_Date = cc.Effective_Date
  JOIN "acme_insurance"."main"."policy" p
    ON p.Policy_Identifier = pcd.Policy_Identifier
),
policy_premiums AS (
  SELECT
    pa.Policy_Identifier,
    SUM(pa.Policy_Amount) AS premium_amount_paid
  FROM "acme_insurance"."main"."policy_amount" pa
  WHERE pa.Amount_Type_Code ILIKE '%premium%'
  GROUP BY pa.Policy_Identifier
),
policy_holders AS (
  SELECT
    apr.Agreement_Identifier AS Policy_Identifier,
    party.Party_Identifier AS policy_holder_identifier,
    party.Party_Name AS policy_holder_name
  FROM "acme_insurance"."main"."agreement_party_role" apr
  JOIN "acme_insurance"."main"."party_role" pr
    ON pr.Party_Role_Code = apr.Party_Role_Code
  JOIN "acme_insurance"."main"."party" party
    ON party.Party_Identifier = apr.Party_Identifier
  WHERE pr.Party_Role_Name ILIKE '%policy%holder%'
  GROUP BY apr.Agreement_Identifier, party.Party_Identifier, party.Party_Name
),
selling_agents AS (

    party.Party_Identifier AS selling_agent_identifier,
    party.Party_Name AS selling_agent_name
  FROM "acme_insurance"."main"."agreement_party_role" apr
  JOIN "acme_insurance"."main"."party_role" pr

  cp.Policy_Identifier,
  cp.Policy_Number,
